name: side_check
sql: do $$ declare agree int; disagree int; begin select count(*) filter (where (o.side_id = 2 and h.side_key = ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name)) or (o.side_id = 3 and h.side_key = ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name))), count(*) filter (where not ((o.side_id = 2 and h.side_key = ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name)) or (o.side_id = 3 and h.side_key = ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name)))) into agree, disagree from public.kibl_now_history h join public.kibl_line_observations o on o.row_key = h.row_key join public.kibl_fixtures f on f.fixture_id = h.fixture_id where ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name) <> ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name); if agree = 0 or disagree > 0 then raise exception 'SIDE CHECK FAILED: side 2/3 vs player1/2 agree % disagree %', agree, disagree; end if; raise notice 'side check % agree, % disagree', agree, disagree; end $$; select 'side check pass' ok

name: side_check_counts
sql: select count(*) filter (where (o.side_id = 2 and h.side_key = ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name)) or (o.side_id = 3 and h.side_key = ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name))) agree, count(*) total from public.kibl_now_history h join public.kibl_line_observations o on o.row_key = h.row_key join public.kibl_fixtures f on f.fixture_id = h.fixture_id where ten280_bot.skey(f.player1_name) <> ten280_bot.skey(f.player2_name)

name: load_timing
sql: select clock_timestamp() t0, ten280_bot.load_ticks(now() - interval '14 days', now()) ticks, clock_timestamp() t1

name: startup_message
sql: insert into ten280_bot.events (kind, detail, net_request_id, delivery) select 'startup', jsonb_build_object('at', now()), rid, case when rid is null then 'unsent: no vault secret' else 'queued' end from (select ten280_bot.send('✅ Stennisfy — Bet105 drop bot is LIVE (test message).' || chr(10) || 'Alerts: Bet105 match winner, ATP / Challenger / ITF Men, pre-match. Fires on a ≥5% drop vs the price 10 min earlier; ignores dropped-to prices below 1.30; 30-min cooldown per match.' || chr(10) || '"opened" = Kibl''s own opener row, otherwise "first seen". Times in UTC.') rid) s returning id, net_request_id, delivery

name: startup_gate
sql: select ten280_bot.settle(); do $$ declare d text; begin select delivery into d from ten280_bot.events where kind = 'startup' order by id desc limit 1; if d is distinct from 'sent' then raise exception 'STARTUP MESSAGE NOT DELIVERED: %', d; end if; end $$; select e.id, e.delivery, r.status_code from ten280_bot.events e left join net._http_response r on r.id = e.net_request_id where e.kind = 'startup' order by e.id desc limit 1

name: cron_health
sql: select d.status, d.return_message, d.start_time, d.end_time - d.start_time as took from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using (jobid) where j.jobname = 'ten280-bet105-drop-bot' order by d.start_time desc limit 5

name: live_alerts
sql: select count(*) n, count(*) filter (where delivery = 'sent') sent from ten280_bot.alerts where mode = 'live'
